auth.signInBody: You can post small offers without signing in. Sign in to accept offers and trade larger amounts.
auth.signInToPost: Sign in to post an offer.
auth.signFailed: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.
auth.tierNote: Post offers up to $100 without signing in (contact required). Wallet, Google or Apple: up to $500. Telegram (phone-verified): up to $1500.

offersList.devModeBanner: Guest mode — your offers are tied to this device. Open via @nomadp2pbot in Telegram to keep your profile.
offersList.title: Open offers
offersList.subtitle: Match with a reverse-direction offer, meet up, trade at a safe exchange point.
offersList.empty: No open offers right now. Be the first to post one.
offersList.valueStrip: Swap cash and crypto in person with people nearby. Your crypto is locked in escrow and only releases when both sides confirm the trade.
offersList.emptyBody: Be the first. Post what you want to swap and nearby people matching the reverse direction will find you.
offersList.how1: Post your offer — it locks nothing and costs no gas.
offersList.how2: Match with someone going the opposite way, nearby.
offersList.how3: Meet at a safe spot, trade, and the escrow releases.

myOffers.title: My offers
myOffers.subtitle: Offers you posted or matched with, active and past.
myOffers.empty: You haven't posted or matched any offers yet.

newOffer.title: Post an offer
newOffer.subtitle: This is just an intent — it locks nothing yet. Crypto locks once you pick a match, so you never pay gas for an offer that never gets matched.
newOffer.directionCryptoToFiat: I have crypto, I need cash
newOffer.directionFiatToCrypto: I have cash, I need crypto
newOffer.walletHint: You'll be the one locking the crypto — connect your wallet above (“Connect”) so it's on file once you get a match.
newOffer.contact: How can your match reach you? (optional)
newOffer.contactHint: Shown only to the person you match with, so you can agree where to meet.
newOffer.contactRequired: How can your match reach you? (required)
newOffer.anonNote: You're posting without signing in: up to ${maxUsd} per offer, and a contact channel is required so your match can reach you. Sign in to raise your limit.

fairness.suspiciousHint: This rate is well off the market price. Make sure you understand why before you meet.
fairness.advisory: Reference only — market rate updates daily; a swap within ±3% counts as fair. Not financial advice.

protection.title: How you're protected
protection.lockedPoint: The crypto is locked in an escrow contract — neither Nomadia nor the other person can move it on their own.
protection.confirmPoint: It only releases when both of you confirm the trade happened. No confirm, no release.
protection.disputePoint: If something goes wrong, either side can open a dispute and a neutral reviewer decides where the funds go.
protection.caution: One rule keeps you safe: only tap confirm after the cash has actually changed hands.
protection.verifiedTestnet: Escrow verified on-chain (testnet — no real funds)
